units.source_text: “有一天，我走进好久没有去的学校图书馆，

en.t: One day, I went into the school library, where I had not been for a long time,

units.source_text: 坐在长桌的一角，上身沐浴着窗外射进来的阳光，翻阅着新到的外国杂志。

en.t: sat at one corner of a long table, and, with the upper half of my body bathed in sunlight streaming in from the window, leafed through newly arrived foreign magazines.

units.source_text: 因为任课老师要我在下周之前，查阅一下某个专业方面的资料。

en.t: This was because my instructor had asked me to look up some material in a specialized field by the following week.

units.source_text: 但是我要查的东西总也找不到，所以我借了好几次杂志，

en.t: But I could not find what I needed, so I borrowed several magazines one after another,

units.source_text: 最后好不容易找到了自己需要的论文，便专心致志地看了起来。

en.t: and at last, after much effort, found the article I needed and began reading it with complete concentration.

units.source_text: 这时，忽然听见宽大的长桌对面，有人小声叫着我的名字。

en.t: Just then, I suddenly heard someone softly calling my name from the other side of the wide long table.

units.source_text: 我抬头一看，是K站在桌子对面。

en.t: When I looked up, K was standing on the other side of the table.

units.source_text: 他俯下身，隔着桌子凑近我的脸。

en.t: He bent down and brought his face close to mine across the table.

units.source_text: 正如你知道的，图书馆里不能大声说话，以免妨碍别人。

en.t: As you know, one cannot speak loudly in a library, so as not to disturb others.

units.source_text: 虽说K的这一举动极其平常，我却感觉自己的心情很异样。

en.t: Although this action of K's was perfectly ordinary, I felt strangely unsettled.

units.source_text: K低声问我是在学习吗，我说查些资料。

en.t: K asked me in a low voice whether I was studying, and I said I was looking up some materials.

units.source_text: 可是他并没有抬起身，低声说：‘咱们去散散步吧。’

en.t: But he did not raise himself up; still speaking softly, he said, 'Let us go for a walk.'

units.source_text: 我说：‘稍等一下，可以去。’

en.t: I said, 'Wait a little, and then I can go.'

units.source_text: 他说‘我等你’，立刻在我面前的空位上坐了下来。

en.t: He said, 'I will wait,' and immediately sat down in the empty seat in front of me.

units.source_text: 我的注意力被分散，杂志也看不下去了。

en.t: My attention was scattered, and I could no longer keep reading the magazine.

units.source_text: 不知怎么搞的，我总觉得K一定有心事，是专门来跟我摊牌的。

en.t: For some reason, I felt certain that K had something on his mind and had come especially to lay it all out before me.

units.source_text: 我不得不把没看完的杂志合上了，准备站起来。

en.t: I had no choice but to close the unfinished magazine and prepare to stand up.

units.source_text: K平静地问道：‘看完了？’

en.t: K asked calmly, 'Are you finished?'

units.source_text: ‘没关系。’我答道。

en.t: 'It does not matter,' I replied.

units.source_text: 我还了杂志，跟K一起走出了图书馆。

en.t: I returned the magazine and walked out of the library together with K.
